001package com.streamconverter.command.rule.impl.casing;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
004import java.util.Locale;
005import java.util.regex.Matcher;
006import java.util.regex.Pattern;
007
008/**
009 * Transforms snake_case strings to camelCase format.
010 *
011 * <p>This rule converts strings from snake_case notation to camelCase notation by removing
012 * underscores and capitalizing the first letter of each word after the first.
013 *
014 * <p>Examples:
015 *
016 * <ul>
017 *   <li>{@code user_name} → {@code userName}
018 *   <li>{@code first_name} → {@code firstName}
019 *   <li>{@code user_account_id} → {@code userAccountId}
020 *   <li>{@code xml_http_request} → {@code xmlHttpRequest}
021 * </ul>
022 *
023 * <p>Usage:
024 *
025 * <pre>{@code
026 * IRule rule = SnakeToCamelCaseRule.builder().build();
027 * IStreamCommand command = JsonWalker.create(TreePath.fromJson("$.user_name"), rule);
028 * }</pre>
029 *
030 * @since 1.0
031 */
032public class SnakeToCamelCaseRule implements IRule {
033
034  /** Pattern to match snake_case transitions (underscore followed by letter) */
035  private static final Pattern SNAKE_CASE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("_([a-z])");
036
037  /** Pattern to match multiple consecutive underscores */
038  private static final Pattern MULTIPLE_UNDERSCORES_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("_{2,}");
039
040  /** Whether to capitalize the first letter (PascalCase instead of camelCase) */
041  private final boolean capitalizeFirst;
042
043  /** Whether to preserve leading/trailing underscores */
044  private final boolean preserveUnderscores;
045
046  /** Private constructor for builder pattern */
047  private SnakeToCamelCaseRule(boolean capitalizeFirst, boolean preserveUnderscores) {
048    this.capitalizeFirst = capitalizeFirst;
049    this.preserveUnderscores = preserveUnderscores;
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  public String apply(String input) {
054    if (input == null || input.isEmpty()) {
055      return input;
056    }
057    String result = normalizeUnderscores(input);
058    result = convertSnakeToCamel(result);
059    result = trimUnderscores(result);
060    return adjustFirstLetterCase(result);
061  }
062
063  private String normalizeUnderscores(String value) {
064    if (preserveUnderscores) {
065      return value;
066    }
067    return MULTIPLE_UNDERSCORES_PATTERN.matcher(value).replaceAll("_");
068  }
069
070  private static String convertSnakeToCamel(String value) {
071    Matcher matcher = SNAKE_CASE_PATTERN.matcher(value);
072    StringBuffer sb = new StringBuffer();
073    while (matcher.find()) {
074      matcher.appendReplacement(sb, matcher.group(1).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
075    }
076    matcher.appendTail(sb);
077    return sb.toString();
078  }
079
080  private String trimUnderscores(String value) {
081    if (preserveUnderscores) {
082      return value;
083    }
084    return value.replaceAll("^_+|_+$", "");
085  }
086
087  private String adjustFirstLetterCase(String value) {
088    if (value.isEmpty()) {
089      return value;
090    }
091    if (capitalizeFirst) {
092      return Character.toUpperCase(value.charAt(0)) + value.substring(1);
093    }
094    return Character.toLowerCase(value.charAt(0)) + value.substring(1);
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Creates a builder for configuring the SnakeToCamelCaseRule.
099   *
100   * @return new builder instance
101   */
102  public static Builder builder() {
103    return new Builder();
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Creates a SnakeToCamelCaseRule with default settings (camelCase, not PascalCase).
108   *
109   * @return new rule instance with default configuration
110   */
111  public static SnakeToCamelCaseRule create() {
112    return new Builder().build();
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * Creates a SnakeToCamelCaseRule that produces PascalCase output.
117   *
118   * @return new rule instance configured for PascalCase
119   */
120  public static SnakeToCamelCaseRule createPascalCase() {
121    return new Builder().capitalizeFirst(true).build();
122  }
123
124  /** Builder class for SnakeToCamelCaseRule configuration. */
125  public static class Builder {
126    private boolean capitalizeFirstFlag;
127    private boolean preserveUnderscoresFlag;
128
129    /** Creates a builder with the default configuration. */
130    public Builder() {
131      this.capitalizeFirstFlag = false;
132      this.preserveUnderscoresFlag = false;
133    }
134
135    /**
136     * Sets whether to capitalize the first letter (PascalCase instead of camelCase).
137     *
138     * @param capitalize true for PascalCase, false for camelCase
139     * @return this builder
140     */
141    public Builder capitalizeFirst(boolean capitalize) {
142      this.capitalizeFirstFlag = capitalize;
143      return this;
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * Sets whether to preserve existing underscores in the input.
148     *
149     * @param preserve true to preserve underscores, false to clean them up
150     * @return this builder
151     */
152    public Builder preserveUnderscores(boolean preserve) {
153      this.preserveUnderscoresFlag = preserve;
154      return this;
155    }
156
157    /**
158     * Builds the SnakeToCamelCaseRule with current configuration.
159     *
160     * @return configured rule instance
161     */
162    public SnakeToCamelCaseRule build() {
163      return new SnakeToCamelCaseRule(capitalizeFirstFlag, preserveUnderscoresFlag);
164    }
165  }
166
167  @Override
168  public String toString() {
169    return String.format(
170        "SnakeToCamelCaseRule{capitalizeFirst=%s, preserveUnderscores=%s}",
171        capitalizeFirst, preserveUnderscores);
172  }
173}
